author: Kalidasa
offset_note: There is NO single printed-to-PDF offset. It drifts +2 → +4 → +6, and the drift is not cosmetic: each step is a pair of printed pages absent from the scan. Anyone mapping a printed page to a PDF page with one fixed offset will silently read the wrong page. Anchors verified by rendering the folio: PDF 15=17, 20=22, 45=47, 51=53, 52=56, 87=91, 130=134, 200=204, 210=214, 211=215, 212=218, 227=233, 254=260, 256=262. Page counts reconcile exactly in all three runs (37↔37, 160↔160, 45↔45). Every `page` in this manifest is a PRINTED page number.
missing_pages_note: Printed 54-55 and 216-217 are not in the PDF at all — the scan skips them. 54-55 sit inside Kanda I Chapter III (Longevity), between shloka 6 (p.53) and shloka 7 (p.56). 216-217 sit inside Second Kanda Chapter I, which is dharmashastra and out of scope anyway. These are unrecoverable from this file and would need a different copy of the book.
structure_note: Organised as KANDAS, each containing numbered Chapters, each containing numbered shlokas. The Kanda level was missed entirely by text-layer parsing and only became visible on the rendered page. The book has exactly two Kandas — the colophon on printed p.262 reads 'The two Kandas of Uttara Kalamritam end here.'
extraction_method: vision — the full TOC read as rendered page images (PDF pages 5-14 at 150dpi); PDF pages 244-256 read as images to enumerate the shlokas the TOC omits; folio strips cropped from a dozen more pages to build the page map. The English text layer was used only to locate candidates, never to source an entry.
why_not_text_layer: This book's PROSE text layer is clean (93% letters, no pages flagged), but the TOC is a three-column table and OCR flattened the columns: page 4 ends '...Directional strength 17 18 18 19 22 23 24 25' — the topic column followed by the page-number column dumped separately. A naive parse of that text silently lost Chapter III entirely and returned zero entries for IV and V. Prose OCR and table OCR are different problems in the same file.
known_toc_defects: The printed TOC is INCOMPLETE for Second Kanda Chapter II: it lists shlokas 1-9 only and stops at printed p.250, but the chapter runs to shloka 29 on p.262. Twenty shlokas are absent from the table of contents — including the lagna-by-lagna benefic/malefic/maraka scheme at shlokas 14-20, which is the most directly usable material in the book. A TOC-driven extraction would have dropped all of it without erroring. Shlokas 10-29 below were read off the body pages (PDF 244-256) by vision and are marked `source: body_pages`.
The TOC entry for Second Kanda Chapter II shlokas 5-7 prints its page range as '248-149', an obvious typo for 248-249. Recorded here as 248.
scope_note: `scope` marks what an astrological KB pass should read. `jyotisha` = astrology proper. `dharmashastra` = ritual/legal material (marriage rites, shraddha, upanayana, ashaucha) which is in the book but outside this project's domain. Second Kanda Chapter I is dharmashastra end to end; it is catalogued in full so it is visibly skipped rather than invisibly missing.

toc_gap_closed.how: PDF pages 244-256 (printed 250-262) read as images; each Devanagari verse-end marker located visually and its English translation used to name the topic. The Devanagari text layer carries no verse markers at all, so this could not be done from extracted text.
toc_gap_closed.closing_evidence: Printed p.262 carries the colophon 'Here Ends the Second Kanda of Uttara Kalamritam' and the note that after verse 22 the author strays into matters covered earlier — consistent with shlokas 23-29 revisiting maraka and longevity ground.
